mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before a custom deck consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your custom deck consultation, it's helpful to have a clear idea of your budget, desired deck size, and preferred location in your yard. Consider how you envision using the space – for dining, relaxation, or entertaining – and gather any inspiration photos or design preferences you have. Knowing your property boundaries and any HOA guidelines in areas like Pleasanton or Dublin can also streamline the initial discussion. This preparation helps us understand your needs and provide the most relevant recommendations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before your deck consultation, prepare your budget, desired size, location, intended use, and any design inspiration.
